title: Your cart
description: Microgreens sown to order, by the 100 g.
heading: Your cart
emptyBody: Greens are sown once you order them, so the cart is where you say what to sow.
deliveryNote: Delivery is worked out at checkout — there is no charge set for one-off orders yet.
readySingle: Sown tomorrow morning, cut the day it reaches you.
readySplit: The things in your cart are not all ready on the same day. Rather than make two trips, the whole order comes on one day — the date the slowest one is ready.
unavailableBody: {count, plural, one {One item in your cart is no longer on sale} other {# items in your cart are no longer on sale}}: {keys}. Clearing the cart removes them.
clearConfirm: This removes everything in it. Nothing has been ordered or charged.
checkoutBody: Payment is not wired up, so this cart cannot be paid for yet. Nothing here has been ordered and nothing has been charged. Your cart is saved on this device for 30 days.
readyWithSeeds: Seed comes off our shelf and travels with this same delivery.
readySeedShelf: Packed from our shelf and out to you the next day.
readySeedVendor: You have asked for more than we keep on the shelf, so we are ordering it in. That is what sets the date.
readyVendorNote: One thing in your cart is more than we hold, so we are bringing it in for you. Everything travels together once it arrives.
readyGrowNote: Greens take different numbers of days to grow, so the fast ones wait for the slow ones rather than travelling on their own.
readyTray: Nothing in this order is kept in stock, so we place it with our supplier the day you order. That is what sets the date.
readyTrayNote: A tray or a mat in your cart is not kept in stock — we order it in for you, which takes a few days longer than something off our shelf. Everything travels together once it arrives.
readyRack: We build your rack and bring it to you across Bengaluru.
readyRackNote: A rack is built for your order rather than taken off a shelf, which takes three days — it travels with the rest of your order on the date above.
